name: American League
longName: American League of Professional Baseball Clubs
notes: Renamed from the Western League and declared a major league on January 28, 1901.

name: National League
longName: National League of Professional Baseball Clubs
notes: Founded on February 2, 1876. The older of the two leagues which constitute current-day MLB.

name: Western League
longName: Western League of Professional Baseball Clubs
notes: Still a minor league, the Western League was renamed American League in 1899, and declared a major league in 1901.

name: National Association
longName: National Association of Professional Base Ball Players
notes: Founded in 1871 as the first professional baseball league. Play continued through 1875, when several clubs joined the National League following its founding in 1876.

name: American Association
longName: American Association of Base Ball Clubs
notes: Several clubs joined the National League following its dissolution in 1891.

name: Federal League
longName: Federal League of Base Ball Clubs
notes: Founded in 1913 as a minor league and operated professionally between 1914 and 1915.

name: Negro leaagues
notes: A collection of roughly seven professional leagues for Black players.
